files.description: Memory paths relative to ~/memory, such as "incoming/paper.pdf" or "papers" for a whole folder. Explicit paths only; globs are not expanded.

output_dir.description: Memory folder that receives one subfolder per document. Default "datalab-imports".

page_range.description: Zero-indexed pages to convert, such as "0-5,10". Applies to every document in the call.

max_pages.description: Convert at most this many pages per document. The per-document cap and the call's page budget apply as well.

mode.description: Datalab mode. Leave unset unless the user asks for a specific one: the mount's mode is already the best it offers, and on the shared key a more expensive mode is lowered to it anyway.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing output folder for the same document. Default false: an existing folder is reported as a failure and no pages are spent.
